query: 帮我为这个跨多次 Codex 会话的仓库迁移创建一个可恢复的 loop 工作流。
Use a Ralph-loop style design to scaffold a bounded research workflow with checkpoints and an evaluator.
把这项需要跑两天的任务设计成 planner、worker、judge 分离的 agent loop。
Create a durable workflow package that can resume after context resets and keeps its state on disk.
给生产巡检任务搭一个带人工审批、预算和熔断的长时 agent 工作流。
Formalize this autonomous content-production process as a checkpointed loop that another agent can resume.
生成 .agent/loops 下的 WORKFLOW.md、state.json、progress.md 和 handoff.md。
Before creating my long-running agent workflow, ask only for the missing completion and authority decisions.
Run the existing loop in .agent/loops/api-migration and complete its next task.
Explain what the Ralph loop is and give me a simple analogy.
Summarize Addy Osmani's article about long-running agents.
Fix this typo, run the markdown check, and stop.
Write a normal GitHub Actions workflow that runs unit tests on pull requests.
Review my existing multi-agent orchestration code for race conditions; do not rewrite it.
Resume the research task from progress.md and deliver the final report now.
Create a one-page checklist for tomorrow's release meeting.
Turn this sequence diagram into a polished architecture visualization.
Set up a recurring automation that reminds me every Friday.
把这个已完成的 schema v2 loop 换一组输入创建成全新实例，旧历史要保留。
把这个旧的 loop 工作流迁移成 schema v3，但绝对不要覆盖原包。
按已批准的新合同更新这个 blocked loop，保留它的 progress 和 evidence。
我只说目标和权限边界，你从仓库自动推导验证器、预算和 breaker，生成一个可确认的 loop。
